description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command:
export SRC="${SRC:-/gt/_work}"
export OUT="${OUT:-/gt/_out}"
export WORK="${WORK:-/gt/_work/work}"
mkdir -p "$SRC" "$OUT" "$WORK"
if ! git config --global --add safe.directory /gt/_work/src 2>/dev/null; then :; fi
if [[ ! -e /usr/lib/libFuzzingEngine.a ]]; then
  _gt_fuzzer_lib=""
  while IFS= read -r _gt_candidate; do _gt_fuzzer_lib="$_gt_candidate"; break; done < <(find /usr/lib /usr/local/lib -path "*/lib/clang/*/lib/linux/libclang_rt.fuzzer-x86_64.a" -print 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -n "$_gt_fuzzer_lib" ]]; then ln -sf "$_gt_fuzzer_lib" /usr/lib/libFuzzingEngine.a; fi
  unset _gt_fuzzer_lib
fi
if ! ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q "libc++\.so" && [[ ! -e /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++.so ]]; then
  _gt_stdlib="$(ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | awk '/libstdc\+\+\.so/{print $NF; exit}')"
  if [[ -n "$_gt_stdlib" ]]; then ln -sf "$_gt_stdlib" /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++.so; fi
  unset _gt_stdlib
fi
source /gt/oss_fuzz_setup.sh
if [[ -d /gt/_work/src ]]; then
  if [[ ! -e "$SRC"/libxml2 ]]; then ln -s /gt/_work/src "$SRC"/libxml2; fi
  if [[ ! -e /gt/_work/libxml2 ]]; then ln -s /gt/_work/src /gt/_work/libxml2; fi
fi
source /gt/oss_fuzz_setup.sh && bash /gt/oss_fuzz_build.sh
